source_text: Up there. See it?

structure.raw_value: ElBaEx.Up there. See it?
structure.script_literal: "ElBaEx.Up there. See it?"

translation: Tam na górze. Widzisz to?

source_text: What, exactly?

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.What, exactly?
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.What, exactly?"

translation: Co dokładnie?

source_text: Who…

structure.raw_value: McWoCl#>.Who…
structure.script_literal: "McWoCl#>.Who…"

translation: Kto…

source_text: Shhh…

structure.raw_value: ElWoOp.Shhh…
structure.script_literal: "ElWoOp.Shhh…"

translation: Ciii…

source_text: It’s been too long. She’s not returning.

structure.raw_value: HoAnEx@.It’s been too long. She’s not returning.
structure.script_literal: "HoAnEx@.It’s been too long. She’s not returning."

translation: Minęło za dużo czasu. Ona nie wróci.

source_text: Have faith, brother. She has a plan.

structure.raw_value: HoBaEx>.Have faith, brother. She has a plan.
structure.script_literal: "HoBaEx>.Have faith, brother. She has a plan."

translation: Miej wiarę, bracie. Ona ma plan.

source_text: We must act.

structure.raw_value: HoAnDe.We must act.
structure.script_literal: "HoAnDe.We must act."

translation: Musimy działać.

source_text: And what would you suggest we do?

structure.raw_value: HoAnOp>.And what would you suggest we do?
structure.script_literal: "HoAnOp>.And what would you suggest we do?"

translation: A co proponujesz, żebyśmy zrobili?

source_text: We still have the Anachorismos.

structure.raw_value: HoBaEx.We still have the Anachorismos.
structure.script_literal: "HoBaEx.We still have the Anachorismos."

translation: Wciąż mamy Anachorismos.

source_text: We will not use the Anachorismos. It was not her plan.

structure.raw_value: HoAnDe>.We will not use the Anachorismos. It was not her plan.
structure.script_literal: "HoAnDe>.We will not use the Anachorismos. It was not her plan."

translation: Nie użyjemy Anachorismos. To nie był jej plan.

source_text: We will give her one more week. If she does not return, we are using it.

structure.raw_value: HoAnEx.We will give her one more week. If she does not return, we are using it.
structure.script_literal: "HoAnEx.We will give her one more week. If she does not return, we are using it."

translation: Damy jej jeszcze tydzień. Jeśli nie wróci, użyjemy go.

source_text: You play with fire, brother.

structure.raw_value: HoAnDe>.You play with fire, brother.
structure.script_literal: "HoAnDe>.You play with fire, brother."

translation: Igrasz z ogniem, bracie.

source_text: I want it!

structure.raw_value: ElHaAg#.I want it!
structure.script_literal: "ElHaAg#.I want it!"

translation: Ja to chcę!

source_text: Ella, that’s a bad idea.

structure.raw_value: McWoCl.Ella, that’s a bad idea.
structure.script_literal: "McWoCl.Ella, that’s a bad idea. "

translation: Ello, to zły pomysł.

source_text: Don’t you see that big, ugly guy, and that demon?

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.Don’t you see that big, ugly guy, and that demon?
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.Don’t you see that big, ugly guy, and that demon?"

translation: Nie widzisz tego wielkiego, brzydkiego faceta i tego demona?

source_text: Nothing we can’t handle.

structure.raw_value: ElFlEx.Nothing we can’t handle.
structure.script_literal: "ElFlEx.Nothing we can’t handle."

translation: Damy sobie radę.

source_text: Ella!

structure.raw_value: McAnOpNo1.Ella!
structure.script_literal: "McAnOpNo1.Ella!"

translation: Ello!

source_text: Don’t let him sound an alarm!

structure.raw_value: DiMaAg.Don’t let him sound an alarm!
structure.script_literal: "DiMaAg.Don’t let him sound an alarm!"

translation: Nie pozwól mu wszcząć alarmu!

source_text: 1Hero!

structure.raw_value: DuShOpNo1^.1Hero!
structure.script_literal: "DuShOpNo1^.1Hero!"

translation: 1Hero!

source_text: Duncan!

structure.raw_value: DiShCl.Duncan!
structure.script_literal: "DiShCl.Duncan!"

translation: Duncan!

source_text: Lillian brought me here. She’s a demon! This is Hell!

structure.raw_value: DuHaEx^.Lillian brought me here. She’s a demon! This is Hell!
structure.script_literal: "DuHaEx^.Lillian brought me here. She’s a demon! This is Hell!"

translation: Lillian mnie tu sprowadziła. Ona jest demonem! To jest Piekło!

source_text: Where is the Toma? Have you seen it?

structure.raw_value: HrAnDe.Where is the Toma? Have you seen it?
structure.script_literal: "HrAnDe.Where is the Toma? Have you seen it?"

translation: Gdzie jest Toma? Widziałeś ją?

source_text: Why would I tell you?

structure.raw_value: DuAnDe^.Why would I tell you?
structure.script_literal: "DuAnDe^.Why would I tell you?"

translation: Czemu miałbym ci powiedzieć?

source_text: We’ll kill you!

structure.raw_value: DiMaDe.We’ll kill you!
structure.script_literal: "DiMaDe.We’ll kill you!"

translation: Zabijemy cię!

source_text: Come here.

structure.raw_value: DuAnEx^.Come here.
structure.script_literal: "DuAnEx^.Come here."

translation: Chodź tu.

source_text: See that box?

structure.raw_value: DuAnEx^.See that box?
structure.script_literal: "DuAnEx^.See that box?"

translation: Widzisz to pudło?

source_text: What about it?

structure.raw_value: HrAnOp.What about it?
structure.script_literal: "HrAnOp.What about it?"

translation: Co z nim?

source_text: The Toma Leolo is inside of there… I’ve been trying to get to it.

structure.raw_value: DuBaEx^.The Toma Leolo is inside of there… I’ve been trying to get to it.
structure.script_literal: "DuBaEx^.The Toma Leolo is inside of there… I’ve been trying to get to it."

translation: Toma Leolo jest w środku… Próbuję się do niej dostać.

source_text: Why do you care about it? How would you use it?

structure.raw_value: DiAnDe.Why do you care about it? How would you use it?
structure.script_literal: "DiAnDe.Why do you care about it? How would you use it?"

translation: Czemu ci na niej zależy? Jak chciałbyś jej użyć?

source_text: Thanks to you and Henry, my Guild is all but dead…

structure.raw_value: DuAnEx^.Thanks to you and Henry, my Guild is all but dead…
structure.script_literal: "DuAnEx^.Thanks to you and Henry, my Guild is all but dead…"

translation: Przez ciebie i Henry’ego moja Gildia jest praktycznie martwa…

source_text: That creepy statue can make me a new army… A better army.

structure.raw_value: DuFlEx^.That creepy statue can make me a new army… A better army.
structure.script_literal: "DuFlEx^.That creepy statue can make me a new army… A better army."

translation: Ta upiorna statua może stworzyć dla mnie nową armię… Lepszą armię.

source_text: You’re insane! We’re going to destroy it!

structure.raw_value: McAnEx.You’re insane! We’re going to destroy it!
structure.script_literal: "McAnEx.You’re insane! We’re going to destroy it!"

translation: Oszalałeś! Zamierzamy to zniszczyć!

source_text: Like hell, you are!

structure.raw_value: DuAnOp^.Like hell, you are!
structure.script_literal: "DuAnOp^.Like hell, you are!"

translation: A właśnie że nie!

source_text: Is it locked? Why can’t you get it?

structure.raw_value: BrBaDe.Is it locked? Why can’t you get it?
structure.script_literal: "BrBaDe.Is it locked? Why can’t you get it?"

translation: Jest zamknięte? Czemu nie możesz jej zdobyć?

source_text: Locked tight… I can’t pick it.

structure.raw_value: DuBaEx^.Locked tight… I can’t pick it.
structure.script_literal: "DuBaEx^.Locked tight… I can’t pick it."

translation: Zamknięte na głucho… Nie potrafię tego otworzyć.

source_text: Where are the other demons? What is this place?

structure.raw_value: BrBaOp.Where are the other demons? What is this place?
structure.script_literal: "BrBaOp.Where are the other demons? What is this place?"

translation: Gdzie są inne demony? Co to za miejsce?

source_text: It’s a temple… The little ones use it.

structure.raw_value: DuFlEx^.It’s a temple… The little ones use it.
structure.script_literal: "DuFlEx^.It’s a temple… The little ones use it."

translation: To świątynia… Mali tego używają.

source_text: This is crazy. Let’s get that Toma and get out of here.

structure.raw_value: DiAnOp.This is crazy. Let’s get that Toma and get out of here.
structure.script_literal: "DiAnOp.This is crazy. Let’s get that Toma and get out of here."

translation: To szaleństwo. Weźmy tę Tomę i wynośmy się stąd.

source_text: What makes you think you can reach it?

structure.raw_value: DuAnDe^.What makes you think you can reach it?
structure.script_literal: "DuAnDe^.What makes you think you can reach it?"

translation: Co ci każe myśleć, że dasz radę ją dosięgnąć?

source_text: We’re smarter than you.

structure.raw_value: HrAnEx.We’re smarter than you.
structure.script_literal: "HrAnEx.We’re smarter than you."

translation: Jesteśmy sprytniejsi od ciebie.

source_text: Hahaha!

structure.raw_value: DuFlDeNo3^.Hahaha!
structure.script_literal: "DuFlDeNo3^.Hahaha!"

translation: Hahaha!

source_text: Duncan… You’re crazy. Lilith is not going to let you use the Toma to make an army.

structure.raw_value: McAnEx.Duncan… You’re crazy. Lilith is not going to let you use the Toma to make an army.
structure.script_literal: "McAnEx.Duncan… You’re crazy. Lilith is not going to let you use the Toma to make an army."

translation: Duncan… Oszalałeś. Lilith nie pozwoli ci użyć Tomy do stworzenia armii.

source_text: On the contrary, that’s exactly the plan.

structure.raw_value: DuFlDe^.On the contrary, that’s exactly the plan.
structure.script_literal: "DuFlDe^.On the contrary, that’s exactly the plan."

translation: Wręcz przeciwnie, dokładnie taki jest plan.

source_text: Enough chitchat. Keep an eye on Duncan… I’ll pick the lock.

structure.raw_value: HrAnEx.Enough chitchat. Keep an eye on Duncan… I’ll pick the lock.
structure.script_literal: "HrAnEx.Enough chitchat. Keep an eye on Duncan… I’ll pick the lock."

translation: Dość pogaduch. Miej oko na Duncana… Ja otworzę zamek.

source_text: I’m not going anywhere… Be my guest.

structure.raw_value: DuAnEx^.I’m not going anywhere… Be my guest.
structure.script_literal: "DuAnEx^.I’m not going anywhere… Be my guest."

translation: Nigdzie się nie wybieram… Proszę bardzo.

source_text: Let’s hurry this up.

structure.raw_value: BrWoOp.Let’s hurry this up.
structure.script_literal: "BrWoOp.Let’s hurry this up."

translation: Pospieszmy się z tym.

source_text: I told you it would be no big deal.

structure.raw_value: ElFrEx.I told you it would be no big deal.
structure.script_literal: "ElFrEx.I told you it would be no big deal."

translation: Mówiłam ci, że to żaden problem.

source_text: So, now what? Are you going to sell it?

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.So, now what? Are you going to sell it?
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.So, now what? Are you going to sell it?"

translation: I co teraz? Zamierzasz to sprzedać?

source_text: I have no idea. But this place is a treasure trove.

structure.raw_value: ElBaOp.I have no idea. But this place is a treasure trove.
structure.script_literal: "ElBaOp.I have no idea. But this place is a treasure trove."

translation: Nie mam pojęcia. Ale to miejsce to skarbnica.

source_text: Andrea sent you here, didn’t she?

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.Andrea sent you here, didn’t she?
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.Andrea sent you here, didn’t she?"

translation: To Andrea cię tu przysłała, prawda?

source_text: Not this time, 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: ElFlEx.Not this time, 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "ElFlEx.Not this time, 1Hero."

translation: Nie tym razem, 1Hero.

source_text: We’re already in Hell… If I kill him, where will he go?

structure.raw_value: DiAnDe.We’re already in Hell… If I kill him, where will he go?
structure.script_literal: "DiAnDe.We’re already in Hell… If I kill him, where will he go?"

translation: Już jesteśmy w Piekle… Jeśli go zabiję, dokąd trafi?

source_text: Don’t kill him.

structure.raw_value: McAnOp.Don’t kill him.
structure.script_literal: "McAnOp.Don’t kill him."

translation: Nie zabijaj go.

source_text: Unless you know how to open that gate, leave me alone.

structure.raw_value: HrAnEx.Unless you know how to open that gate, leave me alone.
structure.script_literal: "HrAnEx.Unless you know how to open that gate, leave me alone."

translation: Chyba że wiesz, jak otworzyć tę bramę, zostaw mnie w spokoju.

source_text: You and I can be kings, 1Hero… And Lilith will be our queen.

structure.raw_value: DuFlEx.You and I can be kings, 1Hero… And Lilith will be our queen.
structure.script_literal: "DuFlEx.You and I can be kings, 1Hero… And Lilith will be our queen."

translation: Ty i ja możemy być królami, 1Hero… A Lilith będzie naszą królową.

source_text: That’s not happening.

structure.raw_value: McAnDe.That’s not happening.
structure.script_literal: "McAnDe.That’s not happening."

translation: Nic z tego.

source_text: The longer this takes, the riskier it gets.

structure.raw_value: BrWoOp.The longer this takes, the riskier it gets.
structure.script_literal: "BrWoOp.The longer this takes, the riskier it gets."

translation: Im dłużej to trwa, tym większe ryzyko.

source_text: Now let’s get the hell out of here.

structure.raw_value: BrWoEx.Now let’s get the hell out of here.
structure.script_literal: "BrWoEx.Now let’s get the hell out of here."

translation: A teraz wynośmy się stąd w cholerę.

source_text: How do we know the Toma is actually inside that box?

structure.raw_value: DiBaDe.How do we know the Toma is actually inside that box?
structure.script_literal: "DiBaDe.How do we know the Toma is actually inside that box?"

translation: Skąd wiemy, że Toma naprawdę jest w tym pudle?

source_text: I have an idea of how we can figure it out.

structure.raw_value: HrFlDe.I have an idea of how we can figure it out.
structure.script_literal: "HrFlDe.I have an idea of how we can figure it out."

translation: Mam pomysł, jak możemy to sprawdzić.

source_text: Why don’t you look inside and see, Johnson?

structure.raw_value: DuAnEx^.Why don’t you look inside and see, Johnson?
structure.script_literal: "DuAnEx^.Why don’t you look inside and see, Johnson?"

translation: Czemu nie zajrzysz do środka i nie sprawdzisz, Johnson?

source_text: I think you should.

structure.raw_value: HrAnEx.I think you should.
structure.script_literal: "HrAnEx.I think you should."

translation: Myślę, że powinieneś.

source_text: Hmm… I see the dilemma.

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.Hmm… I see the dilemma.
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.Hmm… I see the dilemma."

translation: Hmm… Widzę dylemat.

source_text: I know it’s the Toma. You have no choice but to trust me.

structure.raw_value: DuAnEx^.I know it’s the Toma. You have no choice but to trust me.
structure.script_literal: "DuAnEx^.I know it’s the Toma. You have no choice but to trust me."

translation: Wiem, że to Toma. Nie masz wyboru, musisz mi zaufać.

source_text: Enough arguing. If it’s not the Toma, we’re screwed anyway. We can’t stay here forever.

structure.raw_value: BrAnEx.Enough arguing. If it’s not the Toma, we’re screwed anyway. We can’t stay here forever.
structure.script_literal: "BrAnEx.Enough arguing. If it’s not the Toma, we’re screwed anyway. We can’t stay here forever."

translation: Dość kłótni. Jeśli to nie Toma, i tak mamy przechlapane. Nie możemy tu zostać na zawsze.

source_text: Then let's move.

structure.raw_value: HrBaOp.Then let's move.
structure.script_literal: "HrBaOp.Then let's move."

translation: To ruszajmy.

source_text: Duncan… You’re coming with us.

structure.raw_value: McAnEx.Duncan… You’re coming with us.
structure.script_literal: "McAnEx.Duncan… You’re coming with us."

translation: Duncan… Idziesz z nami.

source_text: You’re messing with a powerful monster, 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: DuAnDe^.You’re messing with a powerful monster, 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "DuAnDe^.You’re messing with a powerful monster, 1Hero."

translation: Zadajesz się z potężnym potworem, 1Hero.

source_text: Shut up. You’re lucky we didn't kill you.

structure.raw_value: DiAnEx.Shut up. You’re lucky we didn't kill you.
structure.script_literal: "DiAnEx.Shut up. You’re lucky we didn't kill you."

translation: Zamknij się. Masz szczęście, że cię nie zabiliśmy.

source_text: Lead the way, madam.

structure.raw_value: DuFlDe^.Lead the way, madam.
structure.script_literal: "DuFlDe^.Lead the way, madam."

translation: Prowadź, madam.

source_text: Mother… Daemalius will reveal his true form… He won’t be easy to trap.

structure.raw_value: MlAnEx^.Mother… Daemalius will reveal his true form… He won’t be easy to trap.
structure.script_literal: "MlAnEx^.Mother… Daemalius will reveal his true form… He won’t be easy to trap."

translation: Matko… Daemalius ujawni swoją prawdziwą postać… Nie będzie łatwo go uwięzić.

source_text: We need help. He’s going to leave Erica’s body… He’ll be stronger without it.

structure.raw_value: LlBaDe.We need help. He’s going to leave Erica’s body… He’ll be stronger without it.
structure.script_literal: "LlBaDe.We need help. He’s going to leave Erica’s body… He’ll be stronger without it."

translation: Potrzebujemy pomocy. Opuści ciało Eriki… Bez niego będzie silniejszy.

source_text: My body? I’m not in my body now?

structure.raw_value: ErWoCl.My body? I’m not in my body now?
structure.script_literal: "ErWoCl.My body? I’m not in my body now?"

translation: Moje ciało? Nie jestem teraz w swoim ciele?

source_text: You’re a soul, young lady. You need an Earthly body to leave Hell.

structure.raw_value: LlBaEx.You’re a soul, young lady. You need an Earthly body to leave Hell.
structure.script_literal: "LlBaEx.You’re a soul, young lady. You need an Earthly body to leave Hell."

translation: Jesteś duszą, młoda damo. Potrzebujesz ziemskiego ciała, żeby opuścić Piekło.

source_text: How can we help?

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.How can we help?
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.How can we help?"

translation: Jak możemy pomóc?

source_text: I’m ready for war.

structure.raw_value: BrAnOp.I’m ready for war.
structure.script_literal: "BrAnOp.I’m ready for war."

translation: Jestem gotowy do wojny.

source_text: Me too! Let’s kick his ass!

structure.raw_value: TaHaAg^.Me too! Let’s kick his ass!
structure.script_literal: "TaHaAg^.Me too! Let’s kick his ass!"

translation: Ja też! Skopmy mu tyłek!

source_text: He can not be defeated.

structure.raw_value: MlAnDe^.He can not be defeated.
structure.script_literal: "MlAnDe^.He can not be defeated."

translation: Nie można go pokonać.

source_text: He must be trapped. He is otherwise immortal in this realm.

structure.raw_value: LlBaEx.He must be trapped. He is otherwise immortal in this realm.
structure.script_literal: "LlBaEx.He must be trapped. He is otherwise immortal in this realm."

translation: Trzeba go uwięzić. W przeciwnym razie jest nieśmiertelny w tym królestwie.

source_text: How do we fight a demon?

structure.raw_value: DiBaDe.How do we fight a demon?
structure.script_literal: "DiBaDe.How do we fight a demon?"

translation: Jak mamy walczyć z demonem?

source_text: How can we do anything against a demon in his own home?

structure.raw_value: JuWoCl.How can we do anything against a demon in his own home?
structure.script_literal: "JuWoCl.How can we do anything against a demon in his own home?"

translation: Co możemy zrobić przeciwko demonowi w jego własnym domu?

source_text: As long as the doors to this temple remain shut, no demon can enter or leave.

structure.raw_value: LlBaEx.As long as the doors to this temple remain shut, no demon can enter or leave.
structure.script_literal: "LlBaEx.As long as the doors to this temple remain shut, no demon can enter or leave."

translation: Dopóki drzwi tej świątyni pozostają zamknięte, żaden demon nie może wejść ani wyjść.

source_text: Does that mean we’re safe here?

structure.raw_value: ChWoCl^.Does that mean we’re safe here?
structure.script_literal: "ChWoCl^.Does that mean we’re safe here?"

translation: To znaczy, że jesteśmy tu bezpieczni?

source_text: Safer here than anywhere else in this place.

structure.raw_value: MlBaDe^.Safer here than anywhere else in this place.
structure.script_literal: "MlBaDe^.Safer here than anywhere else in this place."

translation: Bezpieczniej tu niż gdziekolwiek indziej w tym miejscu.

source_text: You say he’ll leave Erica’s body?

structure.raw_value: KiBaDe.You say he’ll leave Erica’s body?
structure.script_literal: "KiBaDe.You say he’ll leave Erica’s body?"

translation: Mówisz, że opuści ciało Eriki?

source_text: Of course. He will gain more power without the human dragging him down.

structure.raw_value: MlAnEx^.Of course. He will gain more power without the human dragging him down.
structure.script_literal: "MlAnEx^.Of course. He will gain more power without the human dragging him down."

translation: Oczywiście. Zyska więcej mocy, gdy nie będzie go ciągnął w dół człowiek.

source_text: I will bring Erica to her body. 1Hero, you focus on distracting that demon.

structure.raw_value: KiBaEx.I will bring Erica to her body. 1Hero, you focus on distracting that demon.
structure.script_literal: "KiBaEx.I will bring Erica to her body. 1Hero, you focus on distracting that demon."

translation: Sprowadzę Erikę do jej ciała. 1Hero, ty zajmij się odwracaniem uwagi tego demona.

source_text: We’ve reached the end, Madalyn.

structure.raw_value: LlBaDe.We’ve reached the end, Madalyn.
structure.script_literal: "LlBaDe.We’ve reached the end, Madalyn."

translation: Dotarliśmy do końca, Madalyn.

source_text: Father… Go with Erica’s soul… Find the body and destroy the Toma.

structure.raw_value: LlAnEx.Father… Go with Erica’s soul… Find the body and destroy the Toma.
structure.script_literal: "LlAnEx.Father… Go with Erica’s soul… Find the body and destroy the Toma."

translation: Ojcze… Idź z duszą Eriki… Znajdź ciało i zniszcz Tomę.

source_text: What!? We will do no such thing!

structure.raw_value: MlMaOp^.What!? We will do no such thing!
structure.script_literal: "MlMaOp^.What!? We will do no such thing!"

translation: Co!? Nie zrobimy nic takiego!

source_text: Daemalius wants it! And when he gets it, he will not hesitate to turn Earth into a realm of zombies.

structure.raw_value: LlAnEx.Daemalius wants it! And when he gets it, he will not hesitate to turn Earth into a realm of zombies.
structure.script_literal: "LlAnEx.Daemalius wants it! And when he gets it, he will not hesitate to turn Earth into a realm of zombies."

translation: Daemalius jej pragnie! A gdy ją zdobędzie, bez wahania zamieni Ziemię w królestwo zombie.

source_text: Just kill him! Why are we stalling?

structure.raw_value: AdAnDe.Just kill him! Why are we stalling?
structure.script_literal: "AdAnDe.Just kill him! Why are we stalling?"

translation: Po prostu go zabijcie! Czemu zwlekamy?

source_text: We need that rock! What about my army?

structure.raw_value: DuAnAg^.We need that rock! What about my army?
structure.script_literal: "DuAnAg^.We need that rock! What about my army?"

translation: Potrzebujemy tej skały! A co z moją armią?

source_text: There is no more army.

structure.raw_value: LlAnOp.There is no more army.
structure.script_literal: "LlAnOp.There is no more army."

translation: Nie ma już żadnej armii.

source_text: Tell me how to destroy it.

structure.raw_value: BrAnOp.Tell me how to destroy it.
structure.script_literal: "BrAnOp.Tell me how to destroy it."

translation: Powiedz mi, jak to zniszczyć.

source_text: Bless the statue with holy water while in the hands of the witch… Erica.

structure.raw_value: LlAnEx.Bless the statue with holy water while in the hands of the witch… Erica.
structure.script_literal: "LlAnEx.Bless the statue with holy water while in the hands of the witch… Erica."

translation: Pobłogosław posążek wodą święconą, gdy będzie w rękach wiedźmy… Eriki.

source_text: You can’t do this!

structure.raw_value: MlMaAg^.You can’t do this!
structure.script_literal: "MlMaAg^.You can’t do this!"

translation: Nie możecie tego zrobić!

source_text: It will shatter into six pieces and will no longer take the souls of humans.

structure.raw_value: LlAnEx.It will shatter into six pieces and will no longer take the souls of humans.
structure.script_literal: "LlAnEx.It will shatter into six pieces and will no longer take the souls of humans."

translation: Roztrzaska się na sześć kawałków i nie będzie już zabierać dusz ludzi.

source_text: You promised me an army!

structure.raw_value: DuMaAgNo1^.You promised me an army!
structure.script_literal: "DuMaAgNo1^.You promised me an army!"

translation: Obiecałaś mi armię!

source_text: What about the plan? I didn’t bring you to Earth for nothing!

structure.raw_value: MlMaOp^.What about the plan? I didn’t bring you to Earth for nothing!
structure.script_literal: "MlMaOp^.What about the plan? I didn’t bring you to Earth for nothing!"

translation: A co z planem? Nie sprowadziłam cię na Ziemię na darmo!

source_text: Watch it! The plan is going forward… without the Toma.

structure.raw_value: LlAnOp.Watch it! The plan is going forward… without the Toma.
structure.script_literal: "LlAnOp.Watch it! The plan is going forward… without the Toma."

translation: Uważaj! Plan idzie naprzód… bez Tomy.

source_text: That’s impossible! What about the demons?

structure.raw_value: MlMaEx^.That’s impossible! What about the demons?
structure.script_literal: "MlMaEx^.That’s impossible! What about the demons?"

translation: To niemożliwe! A co z demonami?

source_text: Trust me. I’ve been here since the beginning of time. I know what’s being sacrificed.

structure.raw_value: LlAnOp.Trust me. I’ve been here since the beginning of time. I know what’s being sacrificed.
structure.script_literal: "LlAnOp.Trust me. I’ve been here since the beginning of time. I know what’s being sacrificed."

translation: Zaufaj mi. Jestem tu od początku czasu. Wiem, co jest poświęcane.

source_text: He’s here.

structure.raw_value: MlAnOp.He’s here.
structure.script_literal: "MlAnOp.He’s here."

translation: On tu jest.

source_text: 1Hero… Take this.

structure.raw_value: BrBaEx.1Hero… Take this.
structure.script_literal: "BrBaEx.1Hero… Take this."

translation: 1Hero… Weź to.

source_text: I’ll use the other one on the Toma once we find Erica.

structure.raw_value: BrBaEx.I’ll use the other one on the Toma once we find Erica.
structure.script_literal: "BrBaEx.I’ll use the other one on the Toma once we find Erica."

translation: Użyję drugiego na Tomie, gdy znajdziemy Erikę.

source_text: Where… will I be?

structure.raw_value: ErWoCl^.Where… will I be?
structure.script_literal: "ErWoCl^.Where… will I be?"

translation: Gdzie… będę?

source_text: We’ll find your body… Don’t worry.

structure.raw_value: KiFrEx.We’ll find your body… Don’t worry.
structure.script_literal: "KiFrEx.We’ll find your body… Don’t worry."

translation: Znajdziemy twoje ciało… Nie martw się.

source_text: Buy us time, 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: KiBaEx.Buy us time, 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "KiBaEx.Buy us time, 1Hero."

translation: Kup nam czas, 1Hero.

source_text: We must move quickly.

structure.raw_value: LlAnOp^.We must move quickly.
structure.script_literal: "LlAnOp^.We must move quickly."

translation: Musimy ruszać szybko.

source_text: Can I fight?

structure.raw_value: HnHaOp.Can I fight?
structure.script_literal: "HnHaOp.Can I fight?"

translation: Mogę walczyć?

source_text: You stay put, young lady.

structure.raw_value: CaAnEx^.You stay put, young lady.
structure.script_literal: "CaAnEx^.You stay put, young lady."

translation: Zostań na miejscu, młoda damo.

source_text: I’m going with you.

structure.raw_value: NeAnOp.I’m going with you.
structure.script_literal: "NeAnOp.I’m going with you."

translation: Idę z wami.

source_text: Nellie…

structure.raw_value: BrAnDe.Nellie…
structure.script_literal: "BrAnDe.Nellie…"

translation: Nellie…

source_text: I’m going too. I want to fight.

structure.raw_value: TaFrEx^.I’m going too. I want to fight.
structure.script_literal: "TaFrEx^.I’m going too. I want to fight."

translation: Ja też idę. Chcę walczyć.

source_text: No way. You two stay here.

structure.raw_value: BrAnEx.No way. You two stay here.
structure.script_literal: "BrAnEx.No way. You two stay here."

translation: Nie ma mowy. Wy dwie zostajecie tutaj.

source_text: Diana… Stay with Duncan. I will go.

structure.raw_value: HrBaEx.Diana… Stay with Duncan. I will go.
structure.script_literal: "HrBaEx.Diana… Stay with Duncan. I will go."

translation: Diana… Zostań z Duncanem. Ja pójdę.

source_text: Shit… I can’t go out there without you, Lilith.

structure.raw_value: MlMaOp.Shit… I can’t go out there without you, Lilith.
structure.script_literal: "MlMaOp.Shit… I can’t go out there without you, Lilith."

translation: Cholera… Nie dam rady wyjść tam bez ciebie, Lilith.

source_text: Stay here. I will meet him in my own body.

structure.raw_value: LlAnEx^.Stay here. I will meet him in my own body.
structure.script_literal: "LlAnEx^.Stay here. I will meet him in my own body."

translation: Zostań tutaj. Spotkam się z nim we własnym ciele.

source_text: I’ll fight with you, 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: MeBaEx.I’ll fight with you, 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "MeBaEx.I’ll fight with you, 1Hero."

translation: Będę walczyć u twego boku, 1Hero.

source_text: You’ll need me. I’m going.

structure.raw_value: ElBaEx.You’ll need me. I’m going.
structure.script_literal: "ElBaEx.You’ll need me. I’m going."

translation: Będziesz mnie potrzebował. Idę.

source_text: Follow my lead…

structure.raw_value: LlAnEx^.Follow my lead…
structure.script_literal: "LlAnEx^.Follow my lead…"

translation: Podążaj za mną…

source_text: We’re coming out, Daemalius… And we’re bringing the Toma with us.

structure.raw_value: LlMaAg.We’re coming out, Daemalius… And we’re bringing the Toma with us.
structure.script_literal: "LlMaAg.We’re coming out, Daemalius… And we’re bringing the Toma with us."

translation: Wychodzimy, Daemaliusie… I zabieramy Tomę ze sobą.
